evidence: Running `bash run_repro.sh` printed `=> creating model 'resnet18'` and then failed with `AttributeError: module 'torch.backends' has no attribute 'mps'`.
The traceback points to `codebase/imagenet/main.py:171` at `elif torch.backends.mps.is_available():`.
steps: Created an isolated Python environment and installed `torch==2.5.1` and `torchvision==0.20.1`.
Ran `python repro.py` via `bash run_repro.sh` with `--dummy` against `codebase/imagenet/main.py`.
Removed `torch.backends.mps` at runtime to emulate the unsupported backend path described in the bug report, then observed the same AttributeError.
